name: Decision Wheel
description: Can't decide? Make your own wheels, add options and spin with ticking sounds.
prompt: A spinning decision wheel with colourful slices, ticking sound, several saved wheels I can name, editable options and an option to remove the winner after each spin.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: ¿No te decides? Crea tus propias ruletas, añade opciones y gira con sonido de clic.
